narr: An anomalously moist environment combined with weak upper level forcing mechanisms allowed for showers to develop across parts of south-central Arizona on the 24th with some showers producing locally heavy rainfall. One of these heavier showers developed over the recent Telegraph burn scar and produced upwards of around an inch of rain. A nearby trained weather spotter in the Claypool area reported approximately 1.2 of rain fell in about 30-35 minutes. The heavy rainfall over the burn scar led to enhanced runoff that resulted in flash flooding occurring in Ice House Canyon. No injuries were reported.
ev: A video from social media showed swift moving water flowing down a creek in Ice House Canyon with known low water crossings along the creek. Timing was estimated from the video. No damage or injuries were reported.
